items.review_rationale: Reviewed vertex-set and set-of-doubletons graph representation, excluding both loops and parallel edges while allowing finite or infinite V; cardinality-two is exact.

references.phrase: edge E consists of subsets of V

references.context: Unordered pair {u,v} with exactly two distinct elements of V, hence u!=v.

references.phrase: family of all two-element vertex subsets
references.context: The collection of all e contained in V whose cardinality is exactly two.

references.phrase: edge family E is a set
references.context: No repeated edge copies because E is a set of doubletons, unlike a multigraph edge multiset.

references.disposition: No loops or parallel copies in this simple graph; no finite-cardinality assumption on vertex set V.

items.review_rationale: Read orbit as full collection of translates g acting on a chosen x under specified left group action, equivalently all points accessible by one group element.

references.phrase: left action of G on X

references.context: Set {g dot x : g in G} with x fixed, taking all elements of acting group.
Members y of X are in the orbit when at least one g in G maps x to y.

references.disposition: Orbit belongs to a chosen element x and specified action, not an arbitrary partition of X.

items.review_rationale: Read the equivalence-class formulation of orbit induced by left group action; verified that reflexivity/symmetry/transitivity arise from group axioms but not from an arbitrary binary relation.

references.context: Relation holds if there exists g in G for which y=g*x; it is reflexive, symmetric and transitive by group-action laws.
All elements y of X equivalent to x under the action-induced relation.

references.disposition: Equivalent presentation of the orbit under the same action; avoid self-referential link to the sibling orbit meaning.

items.review_rationale: Read point stabilizer as all group elements fixing a chosen x under the specified left action; recognized subgroup closure as a consequence, not as an alternative orbit definition.

references.phrase: left group action G on X

references.context: Subset of G consisting of g such that g dot x equals x for fixed x in X.

references.phrase: pointwise action evaluation g dot x
references.context: Evaluation of given left action at an ordered pair (g,x), using the specified group action.

references.disposition: Stabilizer is necessarily a subgroup of G, but the displayed definition is the fixing-element subset.
